job.title: SAP Integration Expert (m/w/d) - Málaga at Einhell Germany AG

tailoring.headline: SAP Integration Expert | SAP Commerce Cloud, Java, Spring & API Integration Specialist
tailoring.summary: Backend developer with 5+ years delivering SAP Commerce Cloud solutions for Rockwell Automation and Shell. Expert in Java, Spring, Spring Boot and REST/OCC APIs, I design and implement robust PIM-ERP-MDM integrations, data pipelines and API migrations. Skilled in CI/CD, Docker/Kubernetes, and production support, I bridge business and IT, translating requirements into scalable e-commerce platforms. SAP Certified Commerce Cloud Developer with strong techno-functional consulting experience.

APIs & Integration: PIM / ERP / MDM integration (Profisee, SAP ERP)

cover_en.subject: Application: SAP Integration Expert (m/w/d) - Málaga
cover_en.hook: I am excited by Einhell’s ambition to connect S/4HANA Private Cloud with SAP Commerce Cloud and other systems, a challenge that matches my five-plus years of delivering seamless SAP Commerce integrations at Rockwell Automation and Shell. My deep experience with Java, Spring and OCC APIs, combined with proven PIM-to-ERP data pipelines, positions me to drive clean-core integration for your portfolio.

bullets.label: Integration Design
bullets.text: Designed and built PIM-to-Hybris data pipelines and API migrations that ensured consistent product data across ERP, MDM and cloud platforms.

bullets.label: API Development
bullets.text: Developed and exposed OCC REST web services for headless commerce, enabling secure, scalable integration with external systems.

bullets.label: Data Pipelines
bullets.text: Implemented Profisee, Hotfolders and DataHub pipelines to automate catalog synchronization, reducing manual effort and errors.

bullets.label: Techno-Functional Consulting
bullets.text: Worked directly with business stakeholders to translate requirements into functional specifications and user stories, bridging the gap between IT and commerce operations.

cover_en.logistics: Based in Karlsruhe, I hold a valid German work permit and am serving notice until 15 December 2026, available to start 16 December 2026. I look forward to discussing how I can contribute to your integration projects.

tailoring.why_company: Einhell is a market leader in DIY power tools and is rapidly expanding its digital commerce ecosystem. Your focus on integrating S/4HANA Private Cloud with SAP Commerce Cloud and third-party solutions aligns perfectly with my proven track record of building robust, clean-core integrations that connect ERP, MDM and PIM systems. I am eager to apply my SAP Commerce expertise to help Einhell deliver seamless, scalable commerce experiences for customers worldwide.
tailoring.motivation_short: I want to help Einhell create a seamless, clean-core integration between S/4HANA Private Cloud and SAP Commerce Cloud, leveraging my proven SAP Commerce integration experience.
tailoring.linkedin_message: Hi, I’m Kranti, a SAP Commerce Cloud specialist with 5+ years of integration experience at Rockwell and Shell. I’m excited about Einhell’s integration projects and would love to discuss how I can add value. Let’s connect!
tailoring.offer: In the first months I will modernize your integration layer by extending OCC APIs and automating PIM-ERP data flows, drawing on my experience with Profisee and DataHub pipelines. I will also ensure production stability through proactive monitoring and rapid issue resolution.
tailoring.insight: Your posting highlights the need to connect S/4HANA Private Cloud with SAP Commerce Cloud; my experience designing PIM-to-Hybris pipelines and OCC API migrations directly supports that objective.
tailoring.email_subject: Application: SAP Integration Expert – Einhell Germany AG
tailoring.email_body: I am Kranti Chavan, a SAP Commerce Cloud developer with over five years of experience at Rockwell Automation and Shell. Einhell’s goal to integrate S/4HANA Private Cloud with SAP Commerce Cloud excites me, and my proven work on PIM-ERP pipelines and OCC APIs matches this need. I can deliver robust, clean-core integrations and ensure smooth production operations. Please find my CV and cover letter attached.
